name: Davepetasprite^2
source:
Davepetasprite^2 is the fusion between Nepeta Leijon and the Davesprite of the pre-retcon timeline. They have a strong urge to join the battle against Lord English, and fight on the front lines.

[spoiler]Having been presumed dead since the Epilogues, they make a significant appearance in Beyond Canon, guiding Vriska when she gets sucked into the Plot Point and begins her progression through the Hell Tiers.[/spoiler]
